request:
"Implement Admin User Role Assignment (CU-AUTH-07 / HU-17) at PATCH /api/identity/users/{id}/role. Load and apply `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` and use Headroom MCP tools (`headroom_compress`, `headroom_retrieve`) when reading large generated files, OpenAPI contracts, or verbose test outputs to minimize token consumption:
1. Domain (`internal/domain`, stdlib only): validate target `role` against the allowed enum (`STUDENT`, `TEACHER`, `ADMIN`, `REVIEWER`), returning a domain validation error on invalid roles; prevent an administrator from modifying their own role (`ActorUserID == TargetUserID` -> `domain.ErrForbidden`).
2. Database (`db/queries/users.sql` + `sqlc generate`): add query `UpdateUserRole` updating `role` on `users` by `id` and returning `id`, `email`, `display_name`, `role`, `cefr_level`, `created_at` (never returning `password_hash`).
3. SQLite Adapter (`internal/adapter/sqlite/`): implement `UpdateUserRole(ctx, userID, role) (domain.User, error)` mapping `sql.ErrNoRows` to `domain.ErrNotFound`.
4. Use Case (`internal/usecase/change_user_role.go`): implement `ChangeUserRoleUseCase.Execute(ctx, ChangeUserRoleCommand{ActorUserID, TargetUserID, NewRole}) (domain.User, error)` enforcing role validation, the self-change guard, and repository update via a consumer-defined `UserRoleUpdater` interface.
5. HTTP, OpenAPI & Wiring (`internal/adapter/http/`, `cmd/api/main.go`):
   - Register `PATCH /api/identity/users/{id}/role` inside the `Authenticate` + `RequireRole(\"ADMIN\")` `chi` route group.
   - Decode JSON `{\"role\": \"...\"}` and return `200 OK` with `{\"id\", \"email\", \"displayName\", \"role\", \"cefrLevel\", \"createdAt\"}`.
   - Map `ErrNotFound` -> `404` (`NOT_FOUND`), `ErrForbidden` -> `403` (`FORBIDDEN`), and invalid role / malformed JSON -> `422` / `400` via `respondError`.
   - Update `contracts/identity.openapi.yaml` and `shared/contracts/identity.openapi.yaml`; wire `ChangeUserRoleUseCase` in `cmd/api/main.go`.
6. Tests (stdlib `testing`): add unit tests for `ChangeUserRoleUseCase` (valid change, invalid role, self-change forbidden, user not found), `:memory:` SQLite integration tests for `UpdateUserRole`, and `httptest` handler tests covering `200`, `400`, `401`, `403`, `404`, and `422`."
expectations: no audit trail of role changes in this slice
no super-administrator tier; ADMIN may grant ADMIN to others
context: area: internal/adapter/http (middleware.go Authenticate/RequireRole, router.go admin group, respond_error.go)
constraint: domain.ParseRole is the existing role validator and ErrForbidden and ErrNotFound already exist

FR-001.title: Set the target role and return the updated account without a password

FR-002.title: Refuse an unknown role, leaving the account unchanged

FR-003.title: Refuse an administrator changing their own role with 403 FORBIDDEN

FR-005.title: Report 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown account

FR-006.title: Actor identity comes only from the verified token

intent: Add PATCH /api/identity/users/{id}/role for administrators with role validation and a self-change guard.

decisions.decision: The self-change guard lives in the use case, comparing the token actor id with the target id.
decisions.why: The guard must hold for any caller path, not only the HTTP route.
The parser and the database CHECK already agree; a second parser would be a third source of truth.
decisions.rejected: Let SQLite's CHECK reject bad values

decisions.decision: The update is one UPDATE ... RETURNING so the response is the post-change row.
decisions.why: A separate read can see another writer's change and report a value that is not the result of this request.

decisions.decision: Roles are compared exactly; a lower-case role is refused.
decisions.why: The stored values and the CHECK constraint are upper case.

plan.summary: Plan: token-derived actor, ParseRole validation, one UPDATE ... RETURNING, use-case-owned self-change guard.
plan.key_finding: Authenticate and RequireRole already exist, so the admin gate is a route decoration; the real work is the guard and the returning update.

tasks.summary: 15 tasks: Setup, Foundational storage and guards, US1 role change, US2 self-change, US3 role validity, US4 admin gate, US5 unknown account, Polish.

implement.summary: PATCH /api/identity/users/{id}/role for administrators with role validation, a token-derived actor, and a self-change guard.

specify.summary: Converged clean: 15/15 tasks satisfy FR-001 to FR-007 with no findings.

approach: Add a UserRoleUpdater port over a single UPDATE ... RETURNING query, a use case that validates the role and refuses a self-change before writing, and an admin-guarded PATCH handler with a path parameter.
